abstract: PURPOSE: This study aimed to evaluate CT- and MRI-based radiomic features of ovarian mature and immature teratomas (MTs and ITs) and to investigate the differences between low- and high-grade ITs. METHODS: A total of 41 patients aged ≤ 30 years with histopathologically confirmed ovarian MT and 23 patients with ovarian IT who underwent preoperative MRI were included. Among them, 51 (31 MTs and 20 ITs) underwent preoperative CT. We investigated the differences in visual findings by radiologists and radiomics analysis not only between MTs and ITs but also between low- (grade 1) and high-grade (grades 2-3) ITs. RESULTS: Multiple CT and MRI findings, along with radiomic features, showed significant differences between MTs and ITs (P < 0.05). Although the maximum diameter of nodular fat was greater in low-grade ITs than in high-grade ITs (P < 0.05), no other visual CT or MRI findings showed significant differences between low- and high-grade ITs. In contrast, several MRI-based radiomic features derived from fat-suppressed T1-weighted images, along with selected CT-based radiomic features, showed significant differences between low- and high-grade ITs (P < 0.05). CONCLUSION: Visual assessments by radiologists and radiomics analysis effectively distinguished MTs from ITs. However, differentiating between low- and high-grade ITs using visual assessment alone was difficult. Radiomics analysis-particularly MRI-based features from fat-suppressed T1-weighted images-showed potential as a noninvasive approach for grading ITs, although further validation is required.
abstract_ja: 目的:卵巣の成熟奇形腫(MT)と未熟奇形腫(IT)のCTおよびMRIによるラジオミクス特徴を評価し、低悪性度と高悪性度のITの差を検討すること。方法:30歳以下で病理組織学的に確定した卵巣MT 41例と卵巣IT 23例(術前MRIを受けた症例)を含めた。このうち51例(MT 31例、IT 20例)は術前CTも受けていた。MTとITの間だけでなく、低悪性度(グレード1)と高悪性度(グレード2~3)のITの間についても、放射線科医の視覚的所見とラジオミクス解析の差を検討した。結果:MTとITの間では、複数のCTおよびMRIの所見とラジオミクス特徴に有意差がみられた(P<0.05)。低悪性度ITは高悪性度ITより脂肪結節の最大径が大きかったが(P<0.05)、低悪性度と高悪性度のITの間で他の視覚的なCTおよびMRIの所見に有意差はなかった。一方、脂肪抑制T1強調画像由来のMRIラジオミクス特徴の一部と、CTラジオミクス特徴の一部は、低悪性度と高悪性度のITの間で有意差を示した(P<0.05)。結論:放射線科医による視覚的評価とラジオミクス解析は、MTとITを効果的に区別した。しかし、視覚的評価のみで低悪性度と高悪性度のITを区別することは困難であった。ラジオミクス解析、特に脂肪抑制T1強調画像由来のMRI特徴は、ITの悪性度を非侵襲的に評価する方法として可能性を示したが、さらなる検証が必要である。
